As a border city in [[Huanglong]] and a stronghold against the [[Tacet Discord]], Jinzhou shares much in common with other Huanglong cities, but has also been influenced by it's unique militaristic history.

==Daily Life==
===Art===
In Jinzhou, leisure activities revolve around watching plays in theater and socializing in tea houses. <ref>[[Ragunna Sales Blitz VI]]</ref> The theater is open year-round, and features Hero Plays, storytelling, and Liondance.<ref>[[Qinghe]]</ref>

The Liondance Troupe in Jinzhou is very popular among citizens, who organize celebration rituals alongside opening ceremonies or intimate occasions such as birthday celebrations and 100-day festivities for babies. <ref>[[Lingyang/Backstory]]</ref>

===Cuisine===
As a Huanglong city, Jinzhou's cuisine features many of the nation's traditional dishes. The most popular culinary destination in Jinzhou is [[Panhua Restaurant]].

Stationed on the frontlines, the diet of [[Midnight Rangers]] is more focused on practicality, especially during difficult times when resources are scarce. [[Food Ration Bar|Food Ration Bars]] are a staple for the Garrison, with each serving coming with a message to soldiers expressing support.

===Echoes===
Due to Jinzhou's history of war against the [[Tacet Discord]], they are often linked to catastrophes and suffering and thus despised. While [[Echoes]] are frequently deployed as tools of warfare, they are rarely admired, seen roaming freely, or used for companionship. <ref>[[Ragunna Sales Blitz V]]</ref>

===Education & Science===
The [[Huaxu Academy]] campus located in Jinzhou has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. The institution specializes in in Wutherology, Ecoacoustics, and Resonology. [[Xiangli Yao]] is the academy's Principal Investigator.

==Economy==
The land of Jinzhou is rich in high-quality minerals, such as [[Lampylumen]], and mining is a very common occupation. The Huaipu Mining Firm, owned by [[Fuyan]], has a near-monopoly over this industry. <ref>[[Alloy Smelt]]</ref>

Buying everyday essentials such as groceries makes up a large portion of living expenses for Jinzhou citizens. <ref>[[Ragunna Sales Blitz II]]</ref>

===Spring Loong Festival===
A festival that takes place inside Jinzhou City, where the streets will be bustling with activity, filled with bouquets and drums of Liondance. Normally, people welcome it with cleaning while merchants release new products to celebrate the arrival of a brand new year. <ref>[[Jinzhou Folklore Journal]]</ref>

==Politics==
===Magistrate===
The Magistrate is the head of Jinzhou's government, responsible for addressing political and military affairs as well as the concerns of the citizens. While the Magistrate has the final say in admirative affairs, they are guided by [[Jué]], the Guardian [[Sentinel]] of Jinzhou, and work with the [[City Hall]] to make these decisions. Magistrates are the only individuals with access to Jinzhou's [[Grand Library]]. The current Magistrate is [[Jinhsi]]. According to Chixia, all of the previous Magistrates selected by Jué had performed their duties well.<ref>[[Rewinding Raindrops]]</ref>

===City Hall===
{{Main|City Hall}}At the core of Jinzhou’s governance structure is City Hall, a parliamentary body where crucial decisions are made for the city. Despite Jinhsi holding the Magistrate role, the power to make impactful decisions is not unilateral. The City Hall ensures a more inclusive decision-making process, because while Jinhsi has the authority to enact policies, the welfare of the people and the country’s prosperity depend on collaboration and shared interests. 

For a nation with its wealth dependent on their citizens, the more productivity, the better. Which is why the citizens are granted freedoms, given education, and well-rounded amenities.  Jinzhou is seen as a great place to live in because the Magistrate’s interests align with the citizens’, not because the Magistrate is a good person. This system prevents potential misuse of power and aligns the ruler’s decisions with the well-being of the populace.

===Ministry of Development===
{{Main|Ministry of Development}}The Ministry of Development takes on the responsibility of safeguarding the general welfare and public services. Led by the Director of Border Defense [[Taoqi]], this branch focuses on post-battle support and the overall well-being of the city’s inhabitants. Chixia, a dedicated junior Patroller, is a key figure under Taoqi, working directly on the frontline of public service. 

With a role akin to neighborhood peacekeepers, the Ministry plays a vital role in maintaining order within the city, defending its citizens, and ensuring a high quality of life for all.

===Ministry of War===
The Ministry of War presides over the military affairs of Jinzhou. The [[Midnight Rangers]] are under their jurisdiction.
==Military==
{{Main|Midnight Rangers}}Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks and the Midnight Rangers defend the northern border without falter, safeguarding Huanglong. As the primary military force, the Midnight Rangers are tasked with protecting the nation from external threats. 

They are divided in the Vanguard for offensive operations against Tacet Discords and the Rearguard to protect the city. The Outriders operate independent from the main troop, focusing on gathering vital information about enemy territories. Their mobility and combat prowess make them essential in navigating uncharted territories and uncovering potential threats. 

This military branch is integral to Huanglong’s defense strategy, deploying wherever the nation’s enemies pose a threat. The Midnight Rangers garrison in Jinzhou is led by General [[Jiyan]].
